experiment: SPIR-V storage/uniform index clamp (1dfd5e009) against its parent main (fac2bc042) and source-built Dawn on intel-host ANV. Scoped native drop-in phase diagnostic; separate backend evidence.

host.label: intel-host
host.adapter: Intel UHD Graphics (TGL GT2), Mesa 24.2 ANV
host.sharedUse: resident desktop app paused with SIGSTOP per window and resumed with SIGCONT; Reploid contributor disabled

providers.main: libwebgpu_doe_c.so from git archive of fac2bc042 (runtime/c/native default flags, gcc)
providers.dawn: source-built Dawn d04f88359391a12375c1a3e948a0b2dcb4c97a18, CMake Release monolithic SHARED, intel-host options of the 20261030 campaign (X11 off, C++ modules off), rebuilt because the earlier binaries were deleted
providers.dawn-aa: byte-identical copy of the dawn harness (A/A)

workloadNote: the two workloads with a shader; buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb compiles no shader and is excluded

sampling.orders: all 24 permutations of the 4 providers, each twice

statistics: dropin_phase_cohort summarize: per-pair ratio medians with bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029); summarized against control main and control dawn

rules.classification: per metric and workload: improvement if ratio CI95 upper < 1.0; regression if CI95 lower > 1.0; otherwise no detectable difference

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports the Intel ANV Vulkan adapter
window gate (tools/intel_window_gate.py): foreign GPU <= 2% of window time, foreign CPU <= 5% of capacity (4 CPUs), no make -C runtime/c process at any sample
acceptance.invalidWindows: gated-window.sh reruns a gate-invalid window fresh, at most 4 attempts; invalid attempts are retained and never used
acceptance.claimBoundary: A result is scoped to these two drop-in workloads on intel-host ANV with these frozen binaries. It is not an application win, does not qualify Intel or RADV support and does not transfer to Metal or D3D12.
